No social/operator field reports in this shard. | Package-space sweep: mix of mainstream vendor extensions (OpenAI, AWS, Vercel), several VS Code agent UX plugins (user-workflow signals), and multiple infra primitives for MCP, sandboxing, browser-headful runtime, memory and security.
